distribution.summary: 甘肃；青海；新疆；四川；云南；西藏
distribution.narrative: Current distribution retains the broader baseline synthesis (Gansu, Qinghai, Xinjiang, Sichuan, Yunnan, Xizang). Wang et al. (2021) provides examined material from Xizang, Qinghai and Gansu and does not justify dropping unsampled baseline provinces.

host_note: Baseline hosts are retained and Wang et al. (2021) adds/clarifies Picea likiangensis var. balfouriana and P. likiangensis var. linzhiensis; Picea crassifolia is shared. Population differentiation and damage figures remain source-specific context.
